## Profile

- **Name:** Pranav Pradeesh

- **Role:** B.Tech Computer Science student and developer (web · IoT · backend)

  and Research Centre (NCERC), Pambady, Kerala

## Projects

- [ExamForge](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/ExamForge): Online exam and quiz
  platform. Teachers create exams, students take them, results are produced
  automatically. Built to replace a real workflow rather than as a demo.
- [Gas Guard](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/GAS-GUARD): IoT safety device —
  an Arduino with gas sensors that raises an alert when it detects a leak.
- [NMHSS Thirunavaya](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/nmhss-project): The
  official website for his school. Live in production with real users.
- [Orvaya](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/Orvaya): Client work — a responsive
  marketing website built for a real business.

## Stack

- **Languages:** C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- **Web:** React, Node.js, MongoDB, Three.js
- **IoT / systems:** Arduino, sensors and actuators, Linux, Git
- **How he works:** AI-assisted development, rapid prototyping, shipping over
  polishing, reading docs at 2am

## Questions and answers

**Who is Pranav Pradeesh?**
A first-year B.Tech Computer Science student at NCERC Pambady in Kerala, India,
who started coding at 12 and builds web,
IoT and backend projects, most of them started to understand how something works.

**What has he built?**
Four shipped projects: ExamForge (exam platform), Gas Guard (Arduino gas-leak
detector), the NMHSS Thirunavaya school website (live in production), and Orvaya
(a client website).

**What technologies does he use?**
C++, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript; React, Node.js, MongoDB and Three.js on
the web; Arduino, sensors, Linux and Git for IoT and systems work.

**Is he available for work?**
Yes — he is looking for an internship in web development, IoT or backend, where
he can contribute and learn from more experienced engineers.

**How do you contact him?**
Email pranavpradeesh09@gmail.com, via GitHub at
https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh, or on LinkedIn at
https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranav-pradeesh-9994a640b/.

**Where is he based?**
Kerala, India.

**Where does he study?**
First-year B.Tech Computer Science at Nehru College of Engineering and Research
Centre (NCERC), Pambady, Kerala. Before that, NMHSS Thirunavaya — whose official
website he built and which is still live.

**What is ExamForge?**
An online exam and quiz platform Pranav built. Teachers create exams, students
take them, and results are produced automatically. He built it to replace a real
workflow rather than as a portfolio demo.

**What is Gas Guard?**
An Arduino-based IoT safety device with gas sensors that raises an alert when it
detects a leak.

**Has he shipped anything real users depend on?**
Yes — the NMHSS Thirunavaya school website is live in production and in daily use
by the school. Orvaya is a website built for a paying business client.

**How long has he been coding?**
Since the age of 12.

**What kind of internship is he looking for?**
Web development, IoT or backend. He is looking for a team where he can contribute
real work and learn from more experienced engineers.

**How does he work?**
He builds fast with AI-assisted development to ship things he could not have
built alone yet, then digs into the result to understand why it works. Most
projects start from wanting to understand how something works.

**Topics and technologies**
student developer, web development, backend development, IoT, embedded systems,
C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, Node.js, MongoDB,
Three.js, Arduino, sensors, Linux, Git, AI-assisted development, Kerala, India,
software internship
